<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
The meeting has been booked by Alison. My final task is to send the confirmation email to all four partners. I will now use the `send_confirmation_email` function to do this. The details for the meeting are: Thursday, November 19, at 14:30.
I will write a simple and clear email body.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>

function.name: send_confirmation_email
function.arguments: {"body":"This is confirmation of the partners' meeting, which is now booked.","day":"Thu","start":"14:30"}
